title: Getting started with Local Services Ads - United States - Local Services Help

facts.fact: Google states that Local Services Ads customers pay only for leads related to the business and the services it offers.
facts.quote: Pay only for leads related to your business and the services you offer.

facts.fact: Going live with pre-badge ads requires completing billing setup and setting a budget, among other requirements.
facts.quote: Complete billing setup and set your budget

facts.fact: Google says pre-badge ads are not available for garage door services, health care verticals, and locksmiths.
facts.quote: Pre-badge ads aren't available for garage door services, health care verticals, and locksmiths.

facts.fact: Google says booking leads are not available for health care verticals.
facts.quote: Booking leads aren't available for health care verticals.

facts.fact: Google says the Google Verified badge is currently unavailable for verticals in the auto, beauty, and dining categories.
facts.quote: The Google Verified badge is currently unavailable for verticals in the auto, beauty, and dining categories.

facts.fact: Google states that pre-badge listings appear in consumer search results but are placed below providers who have completed all onboarding requirements and obtained the Google Badge.
facts.quote: Google will place the listing below providers who’ve completed all onboarding requirements and obtained the Google Badge.

facts.fact: Google warns that if a provider regularly fails to answer calls or respond to messages, its ad ranking may be affected.
facts.quote: If you regularly fail to answer calls or respond to messages, your ad ranking may be affected.

facts.fact: Google states that Local Services Ads are currently available only for certain service categories.
facts.quote: At this time, Local Services Ads are available only for certain service categories.

facts.fact: The Architect service category is available only in California and Florida, according to the page's category list.
The Drain expert service category is available only in California and Florida, according to the page's category list.
Google describes the Google Verified badge as signaling to consumers that a business has passed Google's proprietary screening process.
facts.quote: The Google Verified badge helps inspire confidence by signaling to consumers that your business has passed Google’s proprietary screening process.
